HUMAN_APPROVAL_GATE.notes: Enforced on commercial quotation dispatch (adminReviewed=true required); sequence dispatcher currently lacks a per-lead manual approval flag before SEQ-01

UNSUBSCRIBE_HANDLING.method: UNSUBSCRIBE footer in all sequences; STOPPED_OPT_OUT state mapping

SUPPRESSION_HANDLING.method: Permanent suppression status in sequence store & verification model

BOUNCE_HANDLING.method: Svix webhook ingests bounce, sets STOPPED_BOUNCE and cancels future steps

REPLY_STOP.method: processInboundReply() cancels all automated follow-ups immediately and creates PENDING_HUMAN_OPERATOR_REVIEW

RATE_LIMITING.notes: Per-recipient 72h delay is enforced, but batch throughput throttling (per-minute, per-hour, 20-30/day pilot cap) is absent from the sequence worker

EMAIL_SEND_SAFETY.method: Fail-closed unconfigured provider fallback; Idempotency-Key header passed to Resend

WEBHOOK_SECURITY.method: POST only, nosniff, Svix HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with 5-minute replay window

WEBHOOK_EVENT_HANDLING.method: Idempotent eventId deduplication and event routing

SEQUENCE_ENGINE.method: Strict 5-step sequence (SEQ-01 to SEQ-05) with hard cap at 5; 72h wait intervals

AUDIT_LOGGING.method: Structured history arrays in memory and disk store

remediation_items.current_state: No daily or hourly quota governor in sequence worker
remediation_items.expected_state: Configurable batch rate limiter (e.g. max 20-30 sends/day for pilot, max 5 sends/minute)
remediation_items.risk: Risk of bursting emails if outreach is authorized without pacing
remediation_items.recommended_remediation: Implement DailyThroughputGovernor and dispatch pacing queue before pilot authorization

remediation_items.current_state: Sequence dispatcher checks global outreach authorization, but not per-contact approval flag
remediation_items.expected_state: Require explicit human approval state (e.g. APPROVED_FOR_OUTREACH) on each recipient record before entering SEQ-01
remediation_items.risk: Accidental mass-enqueuing of unreviewed prospects upon global authorization
remediation_items.recommended_remediation: Add recipient.approvedForOutreach === true precondition in dispatchSequenceStep()
